speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn at the Wend Falls (plan M6-M9 §5.4, decision 33): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.wend_falls).

nodes.text: A cairn on the lip of the falls, wet with spray. Its words are half worn away: '...the river leaves, the kingdom stays...'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
